tbc-r1-f1.rationale: Revision applied at A.3 case 3 — the 30-minute threshold now ships with documented calibration ('chosen as 2-6× typical successful-run duration to bound false-positive overwrites') and a v2-deferral pointer to the PRD Open Question. The magic number is now reasoned, not arbitrary; a future maintainer adjusting the threshold has the assumption named. The configurable-knob option (a) was correctly deferred — adding it in v1 would re-open Simplicity-First (no documented second consumer); revisiting in v2 alongside the `--clear-stale-locks` admin verb is the right Phase 1 / Phase 3 boundary.
